title: Companion approval swung on quest choices that had nothing to do with my main crown-loyalist thread (e.g. helping Cal, exposing Aldous) about as much as it swung on the thread itself (swearing to burn hollows, killing the Hollow King) — so a companion's final regard number reads more like an average of many small choices than a clear verdict on the big ones.
